note: Drive access proven from the netemu partition (open, DMA map, ATAPI INQUIRY/READ CAPACITY with the real disc size). Sector data does not arrive yet (DMA path); PS3 control disc behaves the same, so it is not PS2 copy protection.

stages.name: Patch / install / test pipeline and durable HDD log
Netemu partition talks to the drive (open, DMA map, ATAPI commands)
Level 2: emulator disc layer reads from the drive (boot)
Level 4: usable (app, stub ISO, configs, no-disc messages)
